chunks: 1652 - And in the written communications of al-Ridha عليه السلام to Ibrāhīm ibn Muḥammad al-Hamadhānī:
ai.seo_question: Is khums calculated before or after deducting expenses?
ai.summary: This report states a legal ruling from Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام that khums is calculated after deducting relevant expenses. It is a concise jurisprudential text used in discussions of khums and financial obligation.
